label: Uneasy talks
summary: Monday turns on two conversations and one long casualty list. In Kyiv, US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held their first wartime talks with Volodymyr Zelenskyy after meeting Putin in Moscow; both sides paused strikes on the capitals for 72 hours and called the discussions substantive, though nothing was signed. Elsewhere the fighting held. US forces struck IRGC targets in Iran as Tehran prepared to impose its own Hormuz shipping route, Israeli air attacks killed at least four in Lebanon, and drones killed three Colombian soldiers at Ocaña. Nepal and China are still searching for more than 5,000 missing twelve days after glacial floods, and fires are choking Borneo. Germany's AfD took a record 44 percent in Saxony-Anhalt. Markets read a strong US jobs report kindly — the Nikkei rose 2 percent — while Brent held near $96.
